apps.name: Maps
apps.summary: Geographic map preview with coordinate positioning, user-triggered location, external place-search and directions handoffs, and browser-local saved places. Routing, live traffic, weather overlays and integrated geocoding are not yet available.
apps.dataScope: One-time location only after user action; saved places stored in this browser only. No account sync or Genesis access.
permissions: Location permission only after explicit user action.

related.label: Earth Observatory camera directory
related.note: Provider-hosted camera destinations; source coordinates and live status are not yet verified.

apps.name: Weather
apps.summary: Weather Elsewhere prototype using Open-Meteo current conditions for a selected sample of world locations.
apps.dataScope: Selected place coordinates and weather response; browser-local preference state.
permissions: Network access to the configured weather data provider.

apps.name: Clock
apps.summary: Local world clock and browser-local Portal event chamber. Fictional events are explicitly labeled; this is not a trusted precision-time service.
apps.dataScope: Device clock and local Portal event/history state.

apps.name: Notes
apps.summary: A fast private notes, lists and drafts app. No canonical Notes implementation was identified in this bounded Portal audit.
apps.dataScope: To be defined; private by default with explicit sharing scopes.

apps.name: Journal
apps.summary: A private-by-default personal journal. Genesis access must be explicit, scoped and revocable.
apps.dataScope: Private personal records; no cross-capacity or cross-app access by default.

apps.name: Library
apps.summary: EarthChain Books reader preview with a bundled public-domain text and local plain-text ebook opening. Not yet a general synchronized personal library.
apps.dataScope: Book text and reading position stored in this browser.
permissions: Local file selection only when the user chooses an ebook.

apps.name: Photos
apps.summary: VISION PRO includes a temporary capture gallery and an encrypted local vault prototype. Validate backup, recovery, device-loss and key-management behavior before relying on it for important photos.
apps.dataScope: Temporary in-memory captures and locally encrypted IndexedDB records.
permissions: Camera permission only when starting capture; local browser storage for vault records.

apps.name: Camera
apps.summary: VISION camera iPhone smoke test. Its README states captures are temporary and in-memory; it has no encryption, uploads or persistence.
apps.dataScope: Live camera stream and temporary in-memory capture only.
permissions: Camera permission after explicit user action.

related.label: VISION PRO
related.note: Separate camera/gallery and local encrypted-vault prototype.
